headword: {申込用紙|もうしこみようし}

definitions.gloss: application form; registration form; sign-up form
definitions.explanation: A paper form used to apply for or register for something, such as a membership, service, event, or subscription.

examples.japanese: {申込用紙|もうしこみようし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please fill in the application form.

examples.japanese: {申込用紙|もうしこみようし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦もらえます→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: You can get the application form at the reception desk.

examples.japanese: {申込用紙|もうしこみようし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{必要事項|ひつようじこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧、⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ご⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please fill in the required information on the application form and submit it at the counter.

notes:
A compound of {申込|もうしこみ} (application, request) and ⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧ (form, blank paper). The most standard term for a physical application form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {申込用紙|もうしこみようし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to fill in an application form
- {申込用紙|もうしこみようし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧ — to submit an application form
- {申込用紙|もうしこみようし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配布|はいふ}→配布：14410_haifu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to distribute application forms
- {申込用紙|もうしこみようし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ダウンロード→ダウンロード：04725_daunroodo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to download an application form

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{申込書|もうしこみしょ}→申込書：03162_moushikomisho⟧ — application document (often used interchangeably, but ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ implies a more formal or complete document)
- ⟦{申請書|しんせいしょ}→申請書：07486_shinseisho⟧ — formal request/petition form (used for official government or institutional applications)
- {記入用紙|きにゅうようし} — fill-in form (any form requiring handwriting, not necessarily for applications)
- {登録用紙|とうろくようし} — registration form

PRACTICAL NOTE:
While paper forms are becoming less common with digitization, {申込用紙|もうしこみようし} is still widely used in Japan for bank accounts, gym memberships, community activities, and government services. Many institutions offer both paper and online options.
